A Null-Scattering Path Integral Formulation of Light Transport
The document presents a null-scattering path integral formulation for light transport that enables unbiased rendering of heterogeneous participating media. It addresses limitations of existing methods by allowing the combination of various sampling techniques through multiple importance sampling (MIS), improving robustness and performance.
